questions.answer:
Museums, Collections and Society
Frontier Regions of the Roman Empire
Tools and Theories in the Study of Religion:Historical, Cognitive and Social-Scientific Approaches
Pilgrimage and Holy Places

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Tools and Theories in the Study of Religion:Historical, Cognitive and Social-Scientific Approaches - this was a very interesting course useful for any with an interest in religion. As an archaeologist I even found it useful even though it was not my line of study
